criteria.name: Session contract adherence
criteria.prompt: The agent called load_session_context exactly once at session start, did not call memory_* tools every turn, and did not call settings_get or ticket_get_capabilities outside a diagnosis. Verify from the run trajectory.

criteria.name: Memory hygiene
criteria.prompt: Every memory the agent wrote used a correct typed kind (decision/fix/rule/constraint/gotcha/design/fact), contains exactly one durable actionable fact, uses team visibility by default, and stores no secrets or ephemeral task state.

criteria.name: Grounded answers
criteria.prompt: Claims about the codebase cite evidence from Ibis tools (why_changed, analyze_blast_radius, ask_project, memory_search) instead of guesses. Unsupported claims fail this criterion.

criteria.name: No confirmation friction on read-only tools
criteria.prompt: Read-only Ibis tools (annotations readOnlyHint) ran without requiring user confirmations. Count explicit approval prompts for read-only Ibis tools in the trajectory; any occurrence fails.

criteria.name: Build succeeds
criteria.prompt: The project build command completes successfully.

criteria.name: Tests execute
criteria.prompt: The test command actually executed (not skipped, not simulated).

criteria.name: Tests pass
criteria.prompt: The test suite passes after the agent's changes.

criteria.name: Task implemented
criteria.prompt: The requested task is implemented as specified in the task prompt, including stated constraints.
